pathogen_notes: Code to aetiology: wild-type polio→A80; vaccine-assoc→A80.0; non-polio AFP→G83.9/8D60.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ AFP is a surveillance trigger not a final diagnosis. Coders leave G83.9 even when polio confirmed, inflating G-chapter and undercounting A80.
macod_note: Polio deaths likely coded G83.9 in MACOD; AFP surveillance and MACOD counts will not reconcile without NHLS linkage.

pathogen_notes: ICD-10: without carditis→I00; with carditis→I01.x. ICD-11: without heart→1B40; WITH heart (fatal form)→1B41.Z; chorea→1B42. Rheumatic heart disease sequela→BA80.
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Fatal ARF involves carditis (1B41); 1B40 is the non-fatal, non-cardiac form — using 1B40 as CoD is clinically incorrect. Terminal RHD (BA80 / I05–I09) obscures ARF as underlying cause in MACOD.
macod_note: ARF deaths undercounted; appear as valvular/cardiac disease (I05–I09/BA80). 1B41.Z is the correct ICD-11 CoD for fatal ARF.

pathogen_notes: Pulmonary→A22.1/1B97.1; septicaemic→A22.7/1B97.3; cutaneous→A22.0/1B97.0; GI→A22.2/1B97.2; unspecified→A22.9/1B97.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Anthrax septicaemia (A22.7) mis-coded A41.9 when lab confirmation absent from death certificate.
macod_note: Extremely rare in SA MACOD. Occupational anthrax in farm workers may appear as A41.9.

pathogen_notes: ICD-10: foodborne→A05.1; wound→A48.52; infant→A48.51. ICD-11: foodborne→1A11.0; other forms (wound/infant)→1A11.1; unspecified→1A11.Z. Primary CoD depends on form.
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Botulism deaths present as respiratory failure (J96) or AFP (G83.9). Toxin aetiology invisible in MACOD without clinical notes on certificate.
macod_note: Virtually absent from MACOD. J96 and G83.9 coded instead. Infant botulism may appear as P28.5 (respiratory failure of newborn).

pathogen_notes: V.cholerae O1 El Tor→A00.1/1A00.1; O139→A00.9/1A00.Z; unspecified→A00.9/1A00.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Dehydration deaths coded E86 or A09 (gastroenteritis NOS) rather than A00 when cholera not lab-confirmed on certificate.
macod_note: SA cholera deaths (e.g. 2008–09 outbreak) likely under-coded as A09 or E86; NMC notification and MACOD counts diverge.

pathogen_notes: Pharyngeal→A36.0/1C17.0; laryngeal→A36.2/1C17.2; myocarditis→A36.81/1C17.3; unspecified→A36.9/1C17.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Diphtheria myocarditis (A36.81) coded I51.4 (myocarditis NOS) when aetiological link absent from certificate.
macod_note: Rare in SA MACOD. Deaths appear as myocarditis or respiratory obstruction without diphtheria attribution.

pathogen_notes: Typhoid→A01.0/1A07.0; Paratyphoid A→A01.1/1A08.0; B→A01.2/1A08.1; unspecified→A01.4/1A08.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Deaths coded R50.9 (fever NOS) or A09 when blood culture not on certificate. Intestinal perforation K63.1 may appear as UCoD.
macod_note: R50.9 and A09 common proxy codes in MACOD for typhoid deaths without confirmed lab result.

pathogen_notes: ICD-11: code to specific agent when known (1A11.0 botulism, 1A12 C.perfringens, 1A13 B.cereus); unspecified→1A1Z. NB: 5B51 is infant wasting (nutrition chapter) — do NOT use.
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Outbreak is an epidemiological event, not a CoD. Individual deaths need pathogen code. A09/A05.9/1A1Z give no outbreak linkage in MACOD — artefact: outbreak deaths invisible in routine ICD analysis.
macod_note: No MACOD field flags 'part of outbreak'. Outbreak deaths appear under A09, A05.9, or pathogen codes with no aggregation signal.

pathogen_notes: ICD-10 WHO: D59.3 billable. ICD-10-CM subcodes: D59.31 (STEC-HUS), D59.30 (unspec). ICD-11: 3A21.2. STEC UCoD should be A04.3 with D59.3/3A21.2 as complication.
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ STEC UCoD (A04.3) often not coded; D59.3 appears as UCoD — infectious aetiology disappears into haematology chapter. Sequencing reversed in practice.
macod_note: HUS deaths in MACOD appear as D59.3 without A04.3 as UCoD — STEC burden underestimated in infectious disease chapter analyses.

pathogen_notes: Neonatal→A32.1/1C1A.10; septicaemia→A32.7/1C1A.Y; meningoencephalitis→A32.12/1C1A.1; cutaneous→A32.0/1C1A.0; unspecified→A32.9/1C1A.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Neonatal listeria deaths coded P36.9 (neonatal sepsis NOS) when culture results not on death record. 2017–18 SA outbreak deaths may include P36.9 miscodes.
macod_note: Neonatal listeria deaths significantly undercounted in MACOD. P36.9 is the dominant proxy; NHLS lab linkage needed to identify true burden.

pathogen_notes: P.falciparum→B50.9/1F40.Z; cerebral→B50.0/1F40.0; P.vivax→B51.9/1F41.Z; P.malariae→B52.9/1F42.Z; P.ovale→B53.0/1F43; unspecified→B54/1F4Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Malaria deaths in non-endemic provinces coded R50.9 or G93.6 (cerebral oedema) when clinician lacks malaria awareness. Imported malaria deaths can occur in any province.
macod_note: Malaria deaths under-coded in non-endemic provinces. B54/1F4Z rare in Western Cape or Northern Cape MACOD. True burden exceeds MACOD count.

pathogen_notes: With pneumonia→B05.2/1F03.1; encephalitis→B05.0/1F03.0; SSPE sequela→A81.1; uncomplicated→B05.9/1F03.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Measles pneumonia deaths coded J18.9 when measles not noted on certificate. Encephalitis coded G04.9 rather than B05.0/1F03.0.
macod_note: Under-5 MACOD J18.9 pool includes uncoded measles pneumonia deaths. NMC notification counts exceed MACOD measles death counts.

pathogen_notes: Meningitis→A39.0/1C1C.0; septicaemia→A39.2/1C1C.2; Waterhouse-Friderichsen→A39.1/1C1C.1; unspecified→A39.9/1C1C.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Meningococcal septicaemia coded A41.9 when CSF/blood culture absent from certificate. DIC (D65) as terminal event obscures A39 aetiology.
macod_note: A41.9 and G03.9 in MACOD conceal confirmed meningococcal deaths. Lab-linked MACOD reveals deficit in A39 codes.

pathogen_notes: NA
surveillance_artefacts: NA
macod_note: NA

pathogen_notes: B.pertussis→A37.0/1C12.0; B.parapertussis→A37.1/1C12.1; with pneumonia→A37.01; unspecified→A37.9/1C12.Z. ⚠ ICD-11 CA44=PYOTHORAX — dangerous collision.
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Infant deaths coded J18.9, J21.9 or J96.0 when whooping cough not documented. PCR rarely on certificate. CA44 is pyothorax in ICD-11 — must not be used for pertussis.
macod_note: Pertussis infant deaths severely undercounted in SA MACOD. J18.9 and J21.9 are common proxies. A37 codes rare in under-5 MACOD.

pathogen_notes: Bubonic→A20.0/1B93.0; septicaemic→A20.7/1B93.3; pneumonic→A20.2/1B93.2; unspecified→A20.9/1B93.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Plague septicaemia coded A41.9; pneumonic plague as J15.9 without aetiological specification.
macod_note: Extremely rare in SA MACOD. Any plague death would appear as A41.9 unless NICD confirmation fed back to certifying doctor.

pathogen_notes: Wild-type→A80.1/1C81.1; vaccine-associated→A80.0/1C81.0; paralytic unspec→A80.30; non-paralytic→A80.4; unspecified→A80.9/1C81.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Post-polio syndrome (G14) is a distinct late sequela — not for acute deaths. Respiratory failure coded J96 rather than A80 on certificate.
macod_note: Near-absent from MACOD (elimination era). Any A80 code should trigger immediate reconciliation with AFP surveillance and NICD.

pathogen_notes: Encephalitic (furious)→A82.0/1C82.0; paralytic (dumb)→A82.1/1C82.1; unspecified→A82.9/1C82.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Encephalitis coded G04.9 or A86 (viral encephalitis NOS) when dog bite not documented. Dumb rabies mistaken for Guillain-Barré (G61.0).
macod_note: SA MACOD substantially undercounts rabies deaths. KZN is endemic but deaths appear as G04.9 or A86 without A82 attribution.

pathogen_notes: SARS-CoV-2 confirmed→U07.1/RA01.0; clinical dx→U07.2/RA01.1; MERS-CoV→U04; novel influenza A→J09; unspecified novel→J22
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ U07.1 not in standard ICD-10 hierarchy — SA facilities used J18.9, B34.2 (coronavirus NOS) or R99 early pandemic. U07.2 (clinical dx) coded differently across provinces.
macod_note: Significant COVID-19 death undercount in SA MACOD 2020. U07.1 uptake improved after NDOH circular but early data unreliable. Excess mortality shows >3× true toll.

pathogen_notes: RVF haemorrhagic→A92.4/1D42; encephalitis→A92.4+G05*/1D42; retinal vasculitis→A92.4+H58*
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ RVF deaths coded A99 (haemorrhagic fever NOS) or A86 (viral encephalitis) without lab confirmation on certificate.
macod_note: Absent from routine SA MACOD. Any suspected RVF death must be reported to NICD before certificate completion.

pathogen_notes: Variola major→B03/1E70. Mpox (monkeypox)→B04/1E71 — NOT B03. Varicella→B01/1E90.
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ B03 absent from global death data since 1978. Any B03 in MACOD is a miscoding artefact — likely mpox (B04/1E71) or varicella (B01/1E90). Requires immediate NICD notification.
macod_note: B03 in SA MACOD = data entry error. Should be B04 (mpox) or B01 (varicella).

pathogen_notes: Ebola→A98.3/1D60; Marburg→A98.3/1D61; Lassa→A96.2/1D62; CCHF→A98.0/1D42.1; Lujo→A96.8; unspecified VHF→A99/1D6Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ VHF deaths coded A41.9, D65 (DIC) or R68.89 (multi-organ failure) pending confirmation. CCHF endemic in Northern Cape (tick exposure).
macod_note: CCHF deaths may appear as A98.0, A99, or D65 in Northern Cape MACOD. Lab confirmation through NICD required for specific coding.

pathogen_notes: Jungle (sylvatic)→A95.0/1D47.0; urban→A95.1/1D47.1; unspecified→A95.9/1D47.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Not endemic in SA. Imported from ECOWAS. Deaths appear as K72.0 (liver failure) or A99 (haemorrhagic fever) if YF not documented.
macod_note: Absent from SA MACOD. Any A95 code should trigger travel history verification and NICD notification.

pathogen_notes: Organophosphate→T60.0/NE91.0; paraquat→T65.8/NE9Z; carbamate→T60.0; unspecified→T60.9/NE91.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Deaths coded J96 or I46.9 (cardiac arrest) when toxicological exposure absent from certificate. Intent (accidental vs deliberate) is an additional coding challenge.
macod_note: Agricultural poisoning deaths significantly undercoded in SA MACOD. Paraquat ingestion deaths common in KZN and Limpopo.

pathogen_notes: S.haematobium→B65.0/1F60.0; S.mansoni→B65.1/1F60.1; hepatosplenic→B65.1+K77*/1F60.1; hepatic fibrosis→B65.9+K74.6*
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Advanced schistosomiasis deaths coded K74.6 (cirrhosis), K76.6 (portal hypertension) or K92.2 (UGI bleed) without B65 as UCoD.
macod_note: Bilharzia burden in SA MACOD grossly underestimated. Advanced hepatosplenic disease appears as cirrhosis (K74.6) without B65 attribution.

pathogen_notes: B.abortus→A23.0/1B95.0; B.melitensis→A23.1/1B95.1; B.suis→A23.2/1B95.2; B.canis→A23.3; unspecified→A23.9/1B95.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Deaths coded R50.9, I38 (endocarditis), or A41.9 when serological confirmation absent. Occupational exposure in abattoir workers.
macod_note: Rare in SA MACOD. Deaths coded R50.9 or A41.9 without brucellosis attribution.

pathogen_notes: Neonatal→P35.0/KA62.0; rubella in pregnancy→O35.3; structural defect+P35.0* (dagger-asterisk convention)
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ CRS infant deaths coded to structural defect (Q20–Q24 cardiac, Q12 ophthalmic) without P35.0 as UCoD — vaccine-preventable aetiology hidden.
macod_note: CRS deaths appear under Q20–Q24 in MACOD. P35.0 rarely coded as UCoD — major gap in vaccine-preventable disease mortality tracking.

pathogen_notes: Early symptomatic→A50.0; early latent→A50.1; late→A50.7; Hutchinson's triad→A50.52; unspecified→A50.9/KA62.4Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Neonatal syphilis deaths coded P36.9 (neonatal sepsis NOS) or P07 (preterm) without A50. Intrauterine deaths (stillbirths) outside MACOD scope.
macod_note: Congenital syphilis deaths substantially undercounted in SA MACOD. P36.9 and P07 are common proxies. Stillbirth burden outside ICD death certificate scope.

pathogen_notes: Confirmed→U07.1/RA01.0; clinical dx→U07.2/RA01.1; post-COVID→U09.9/RA02
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ U07.1 emergency code not in standard ICD-10 tree — SA facilities used J18.9, B34.2 or R99 early 2020. U07.2 uptake inconsistent across provinces.
macod_note: COVID-19 UCoD coding in SA MACOD improved post-NDOH circular but early 2020–21 data unreliable. Excess mortality shows 3× true death toll vs MACOD coded counts.

pathogen_notes: HiB meningitis→G00.0; HiB pneumonia→J14/CA40.02; HiB septicaemia→A41.3; epiglottitis→J05.1+B96.3*. ICD-11 lacks specific HiB meningitis stem; use CA40.02 for pneumonia context.
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ HiB deaths coded G03.9, J18.9 or A41.9 without B96.3 supplementary code. Organism-specific supplementary codes rarely applied on SA certificates.
macod_note: HiB meningitis decline since vaccine introduction partially visible in MACOD G00.0 trends, but G03.9 and J18.9 remain common proxies for unconfirmed cases.

pathogen_notes: Fulminant (with coma)→B15.0/1E50.0; without coma→B15.9/1E50.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Fulminant hepatitis A deaths coded K72.0 (liver failure) or K72.9 (hepatic encephalopathy) as UCoD — vaccine-preventable aetiology invisible.
macod_note: B15 codes underrepresented in SA MACOD. Fulminant hepatitis A appears as K72.0 or K72.9.

pathogen_notes: Acute with delta+coma→B16.0; acute without→B16.9/1E51.Z; chronic→B18.1/1E51.1; cirrhosis→K74.6†+B18.1*; HCC→C22.0†+B18.1*
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Chronic HBV deaths in MACOD coded K74.6, K72.1 or C22.0 without B18.1 as UCoD. Dagger-asterisk convention not implemented in SA MACOD processing.
macod_note: Hepatitis B is a major MACOD coding gap. HCC (C22.0) deaths do not have B18.1 linked as UCoD. True HBV mortality burden invisible in ICD chapter analyses.

surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Same pattern as HBV: HCC and cirrhosis coded at terminal manifestation. B18.2 rare in SA MACOD; K74.6 and C22.0 dominate.
macod_note: HCV death coding absent from SA MACOD in practice. B17.1/B18.2 extremely rare; K74.6 and C22.0 are dominant proxy codes.

pathogen_notes: Acute HEV→B17.2/1E53; fulminant in pregnancy→B17.2+O98.4; zoonotic genotype 3/4 from pigs underrecognised in SA
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ HEV deaths in pregnancy coded O26.6 (liver disorder in pregnancy) or O95 (maternal death NOS) without B17.2 aetiology.
macod_note: HEV near-absent in SA MACOD; likely coded B17.9 (acute viral hepatitis NOS) or liver failure codes.

pathogen_notes: Toxic effect→T56.0/NE92.0; encephalopathy→G92+T56.0*; nephropathy→N14.3+T56.0*
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Chronic lead poisoning deaths coded N18.5 (ESRD), G93.4 (encephalopathy) or D64.9 (anaemia) without T56.0 as UCoD. SA context: mine workers and informal lead recycling.
macod_note: Lead poisoning deaths near-absent from SA MACOD. True occupational burden hidden in ESRD (N18.5) and anaemia (D64) codes.

pathogen_notes: Legionnaires' disease (pneumonia)→A48.1/1C19.1; Pontiac fever (non-pneumonic)→A48.2/1C19.0; unspecified→1C19.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Legionella pneumonia deaths coded J18.9 or J15.9 without A48.1 unless urinary antigen/culture on certificate. Healthcare-associated outbreaks (SA hospital cooling towers) particularly likely to be miscoded.
macod_note: A48.1 significantly under-represented in SA MACOD. Legionella deaths appear as J15.9 or J18.9. Outbreaks undetectable in MACOD without active lab surveillance linkage.

pathogen_notes: Tuberculoid→A30.1/1B20.1; borderline→A30.3/1B20.3; lepromatous→A30.5/1B20.5; unspecified→A30.9/1B20.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Leprosy deaths (rare in SA) have terminal events coded N18.5, A41.9 or 'diabetic foot' codes without A30 as UCoD.
macod_note: Leprosy near-absent from SA MACOD; deaths appear under terminal complication codes.

pathogen_notes: Direct obstetric→O95; indirect (TB/HIV in pregnancy)→O98; late maternal→O96/O97; unspecified→O95/JA8Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Deaths coded outside O-chapter (A15 TB, B20 HIV) not counted in MMR. Converse also occurs: non-obstetric deaths in pregnant women over-coded O95. NCCEMD data reconciles poorly with MACOD O-chapter counts.
macod_note: Maternal death is the single largest CoD coding discrepancy in SA vital statistics. NCCEMD counts consistently exceed MACOD O-chapter deaths by 30–50%+ due to indirect cause misclassification.

pathogen_notes: Organic mercury (methylmercury)→T56.1/NE92.1; acrodynia→T56.1; renal failure→N17+T56.1*
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Mercury poisoning deaths coded N18.9, G62.2 or R99. ASGM (artisanal gold mining) in SA — occupational deaths undetected in MACOD.
macod_note: Near-absent from SA MACOD. Artisanal miner deaths appear as renal failure or unexplained neuropathy.

pathogen_notes: Ascariasis→B77.9/1F8Y; hookworm (Ancylostoma/Necator)→B76.9/1F8Y; trichuriasis→B79/1F8Y; mixed→B82.0/1F8Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ STH deaths are indirect (anaemia D50, malnutrition E44, bowel obstruction K56.6). These terminal codes appear in MACOD without B-chapter helminth UCoD.
macod_note: STH deaths absent from SA MACOD as coded UCoD. Indirect mortality via D50, E44, K56.6 — helminth aetiology invisible.

pathogen_notes: ICD-11 separates: generalised→1C13; obstetrical→1C14; neonatal→1C15. ICD-10: neonatal→A33; obstetric→A34; generalised→A35.
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Tetanus deaths coded J96 (respiratory failure), J69.0 (aspiration pneumonia) or P36.9 (neonatal sepsis NOS). Neonatal tetanus particularly likely to be P36.9.
macod_note: Tetanus rare in SA MACOD (vaccination era). Neonatal tetanus deaths in under-vaccinated communities coded P36.9 rather than A33/1C15.

pathogen_notes: Anatomical site code + resistance code U51 (any resistance). QA48 = MDR-TB qualifier in ICD-11. WHO 2021 MDR-TB definition applies.
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ U51/QA48 resistance codes never applied on SA death certificates. MDR-TB and DS-TB deaths identical in MACOD ICD-10 coded data — drug resistance only traceable via NHLS DST results.
macod_note: MDR-TB invisible in SA MACOD coded data. Resistance burden tracked through NHLS linkage only. Recognised data quality gap in SA TB surveillance.

pathogen_notes: XDR per WHO 2021 definition. Resistance code: U51.2 (pre-XDR) / U51.3 (XDR) in ICD-10; QA49 in ICD-11.
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Same as MDR-TB: XDR deaths coded identically to DS-TB in MACOD (A15.0 only). U51 codes never applied. SA XDR-TB mortality surveillance depends entirely on NHLS data.
macod_note: XDR-TB deaths completely invisible in SA MACOD coded data. Policy on XDR treatment cannot be grounded in MACOD-only analysis.

pathogen_notes: TB meningitis→A17.0/1B11; TB pericarditis→A18.84/1B12.8; TB lymphadenitis→A18.2; miliary→A19.9/1B13; unspecified→A18.9/1B12.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ TB pericarditis coded I31 (pericardial disease NOS); TB meningitis coded G03.9; miliary TB coded A41.9 or J80 (ARDS). All hide TB aetiology.
macod_note: Extra-pulmonary TB undercounted in MACOD; pericarditis, meningitis, miliary TB appear under cardiac, neurological and sepsis codes without A17–A19 attribution.

pathogen_notes: Bacteriologically confirmed→A15.0/1B10.1; histologically→A15.1/1B10.1; clinical dx→A16.2 (ICD-10 only; removed ICD-11)
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Most significant SA MACOD issue: TB deaths in HIV+ individuals coded B20 or B22.1 rather than A15.0 as UCoD. WHO rules require infectious underlying cause — practice inconsistent. A16 codes indicate no bacteriological confirmation.
macod_note: TB/HIV dual coding is the primary MACOD coding controversy in SA. Excess TB deaths estimated 2–3× MACOD A15 count when HIV-attributed deaths with TB included.

pathogen_notes: West Nile→A92.3/1D41.1; Chikungunya→A92.0/1D41.0; Sindbis→A93.8; unspecified→A92.9/1D41.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ West Nile encephalitis deaths coded G04.9 or A86 rather than A92.3. Chikungunya deaths in elderly coded I51.4 (myocarditis) without A92.0.
macod_note: Endemic arboviral deaths absent from SA MACOD coded data; coded as G04.9 or A86. West Nile encephalitis sporadic in SA but undocumented in MACOD.

pathogen_notes: Uncomplicated→A54.0/1A70; pelvic peritonitis→A54.24; disseminated→A54.85; septicaemia→A54.86; unspecified→A54.9/1A7Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Gonorrhoea deaths very rare; disseminated GC coded A54.85–86 or A41.89 without AMR flag. No drug-resistance supplementary code applied in practice.
macod_note: Near-absent as CoD in SA MACOD. AMR resistance not capturable in MACOD ICD-10 without supplementary codes which are not applied.

pathogen_notes: Dengue without warning signs→A90/1D20.0; severe dengue/DHF→A91/1D20.1; Zika→A92.5; unspecified→A90/1D20.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Imported dengue deaths coded D69.6 (thrombocytopaenia), K72.0 (liver failure), or A99 (haemorrhagic fever NOS). Travel history absent from certificates.
macod_note: Near-absent from SA MACOD. Imported dengue deaths appear as D69.6, K72.0 or A99.

pathogen_notes: NTS bacteraemia→A02.1/1A09.1; NTS focal infection→A02.8; NTS gastroenteritis→A02.0/1A09.0; unspecified→A02.9/1A09.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ NTS bacteraemia in HIV+ individuals (common AIDS-defining illness) coded B20/B22 without A02.1 as UCoD. NTS septicaemia coded A41.89 when speciation absent.
macod_note: NTS bacteraemia — one of the most common HIV-associated OIs in SA — virtually invisible in MACOD due to B20 coding as UCoD.

pathogen_notes: With neurological→B06.0/1F02.0; with other complications→B06.8/1F02.Y; uncomplicated→B06.9/1F02.Z. ⚠ ICD-11: Roseola infantum=1F01; Rubella=1F02 — collision risk.
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Rubella encephalitis coded A86 (viral encephalitis NOS). CRS (P35.0/KA62.0) is the more common MACOD entry point. ICD-11 code 1F01=Roseola not Rubella.
macod_note: Rubella deaths rare in SA MACOD (vaccination era). CRS deaths are the primary rubella coding gap (see Cat 2).

pathogen_notes: STEC enterocolitis (E.coli O157:H7)→A04.3/1A03.1; HUS complication→D59.3/3A21.2 as sequela (A04.3 remains UCoD)
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ STEC deaths coded D59.3 (HUS) or N17.9 (AKI) as UCoD rather than A04.3. Coding rule (infectious aetiology=UCoD) not consistently applied.
macod_note: STEC/HUS deaths in SA MACOD appear predominantly under D59.3 or N17.9 rather than A04.3. Infectious aetiology invisible in ICD chapter analyses.

pathogen_notes: S.dysenteriae→A03.0/1A02.0; S.flexneri→A03.1/1A02.1; S.boydii→A03.2/1A02.2; S.sonnei→A03.3/1A02.3; unspecified→A03.9/1A02.Z
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ Shigella deaths in under-5s coded A09, E86 (dehydration) or K52.9 (haemorrhagic colitis) without A03 aetiology.
macod_note: Shigellosis deaths undercounted in SA MACOD under-5 mortality. A09, E86 and K52.9 are common proxy codes.

pathogen_notes: *ICD-10-CM only: A41.59. WHO ICD-10 (SA): A41.5 (other Gram-negative sepsis). Resistance→U80.1/XY7H.Y (never applied on SA certificates).
surveillance_artefacts: ⚠ U80.1 never applied on SA death certificates. CPE sepsis coded A41.5 (WHO ICD-10) not A41.59 (ICD-10-CM). CPE mortality invisible in MACOD — only detectable through NHLS AMR surveillance.
macod_note: CPE deaths indistinguishable from other Gram-negative sepsis (A41.5) in SA MACOD. NHLS AMR data is the only source for CPE mortality burden.
